responsibility: This header defines GCC's host-side wide integer types, limits, format strings, and inline arithmetic/bit-manipulation helpers for HOST_WIDE_INT and HOST_WIDEST_FAST_INT. It establishes the canonical 64-bit host integer model used by the compiler itself, exposes operations such as clz/ctz/ffs/popcount, exact/floor/ceil log2, sign and zero extension, absolute value, and checked add/mul, and provides the formatting macros needed for diagnostics and dumps of host-wide integers.
same_name_distinction: Defines GCC's host-wide integer types, limits, format macros, and the primary inline bit/arithmetic helpers used throughout the compiler. The .cc companion exists mainly for out-of-line arithmetic helpers and legacy fallback implementations.
